note: The WhatsApp templates as Meta approves them, one entry per message_templates row. Body text and the order of parameters are the contract: we fill {{1}}..{{n}} positionally, so re-wording is free but re-ordering silently sends the wrong values. The button carries its own {{1}}, numbered separately from the body, and Meta only accepts it as a dynamic URL when an example value is submitted with it. web/scripts/zavu-templates.mjs prints these as form fields and as the SQL that records the ids Zavu gives back. The button URL is the address the site answers on today; when the custom domain is connected it changes here and in every template already approved with Zavu, or every button a parent taps stops resolving.
